author: N6rL
content: Implementation plan: (1) fixtures/raw_document/ directory at repo root with 4 JSON files: 01_academic_pdf_clean.json, 02_scanned_document_ocr.json, 03_web_article.json, 04_edge_cases.json (no DOI, empty blocks, Unicode titles, missing optionals). (2) tests/test_membrane_fixtures.py — Python test that loads each fixture, parses with RawDocument.model_validate_json(), verifies round-trip by re-serializing and checking JSON equality via dict comparison. (3) alcanzai-core/tests/membrane.rs — Rust integration tests that (a) deserialize every fixture with RawDocument::try_from_json(), (b) round-trip stability: deserialize → to_json() → deserialize again and compare key fields, (c) negative drift test: a 'bad_unknown_field.json' fixture with an unknown field must fail deserialization. (4) Pre-commit hook entry: fast Python membrane test added to local gate (already marked 'not integration' so it runs in pytest-fast). Rust membrane tests run under cargo test. No new CI step needed — already covered by existing pipeline matrix.
